about_lede: Explore illustrated decks, create cards on any topic in six languages, and bring new words to life — on any screen, or printed on card stock and posted to your door.
about_step_create: Name a topic and a language; Snapcards drafts and illustrates the deck.
about_step_explore: Flip through the cards on any screen, at the child’s own pace.
about_step_print: Print at home or at a print shop, or have postcards printed and delivered.

about_signoff: Built in Brazil. Shared with the world.

kids_lede: Make an illustrated flashcard deck about anything your child loves — animals, colours, the planets — and learn new words together, in six languages.
kids_b1: Name a topic — dinosaurs, fruit, the farm — and Snapcards writes the words and draws a picture for every card.
kids_b2: Flip each card when they’re ready and go back as often as they like, on a phone, a tablet or a computer.
kids_b3: Portuguese, Spanish, English, Hebrew, Chinese and Hindi: the same pictures for a first language or a second one.
teachers_lede: Turn tomorrow’s lesson into an illustrated flashcard deck in minutes: show it to the class, print it for hands-on activities, and share it with your students.
teachers_b1: Type the lesson’s topic, choose up to 20 cards, and get the words and pictures ready to teach.
teachers_b2_title: Print at school or at a shop
teachers_b2: A4 or Letter sheets with cut lines, single or double-sided, on the school printer or at a print shop.
teachers_b3: Every deck has its own link: send it to students and families to review the cards at home.
printed_lede: Create an illustrated deck, then have it printed and delivered: a spiral flip-deck in Brazil, two-sided postcards in the other countries we ship to.
printed_benefits_label: From your screen to your mailbox
printed_b1: Every card you create, picture and word, printed in colour on sturdy card stock.
printed_b2: An A6 Wire-O spiral flip-deck, printed in Brazil and sent by Correios SEDEX.
printed_b3: Two-sided 6 × 4 in postcards, printed and posted to Argentina, Israel, the United States, the United Kingdom, China and India.
printed_where: We deliver to Brazil, Argentina, Israel, the United States, the United Kingdom, China and India. You see the price before you pay.
